blocks.html: Where the foundation design relies on rock to support footings, deep foundations or caisson sockets, or permanent prestressed rock anchors, a sufficient number of rock corings shall be drilled to sufficient depths to assess the competency of the rock and its load-bearing capacity, but no less than 10 feet (3048 mm) below the lowest level of bearing.
